context: The team wants every PR reviewed by someone with domain ownership before merge, not just any approval.
explanation: Safe to merge. Adds a `CODEOWNERS` file mapping paths to owning teams, plus a workflow that checks for at least one submitted approval and fails the check if none exists. Permissions are scoped to read-only (`contents: read`, `pull-requests: read`), which is all `listReviews` needs. This is a standard, low-risk way to enforce review discipline and pairs naturally with a required-status-check branch protection rule.
